RAZI-FULL (الحسن): Al-Hasan says the successor is Adam's descendants, who follow one another, supported by the verse about successors on earth. {"id": "2:30/q20", "question": "What happened on earth before Adam?", "turns_on": "", "positions": [{"id": "2:30/q20/p1", "position": "Jinn inhabited earth, corrupted it, and were defeated by angels before Adam", "reasons": "MUQATIL (author): Jinn first inhabited earth, angels heaven; envious, fighting jinn were defeated by a fiery host under Iblis. MUQATIL (author): Corruption means sins and bloodshed wrongfully, as earlier jinn did. TAB-FULL (author): Ibn Abbas reports jinn first corrupted earth and Adam succeeded them. ZAJJAJ (قيل): A people called jinn lived on earth, corrupted it and shed blood; God sent angels to drive them away, and the angels then inhabited earth. THALABI (المفسرون): Exegetes recount that jinn first worshipped on earth, then envy and aggression led them to fight and corrupt it. THALABI (المفسرون): An angelic force called jinn, led by Iblis, expelled the earlier jinn to mountains and sea islands and took over earth. THALABI (أكثر المفسرين): Most exegetes say the angels inferred human corruption by analogy with the earlier jinn, reasoning from the witnessed to the unseen. MAWARDI-FULL (author): Alternatively, the question form expresses an assertion; the angels inferred corruption from the jinn who had inhabited earth before. TABRISI (ابن عباس): Ibn Abbas reports that jinn lived on earth, corrupted it and shed blood, were destroyed, and were replaced by Adam and his descendants. QURTUBI-FULL (أحمد بن يحيى ثعلب): Thaʿlab says the angels had seen jinn corrupt and shed blood on earth before Adam; God sent Satan with an angelic host to kill them and drive them to seas and mountains, so they asked whether the human successor would be like the jinn. NASAFI-FULL (author): Before Adam, jinn inhabited earth and corrupted it; angels expelled them to islands, seas, and mountaintops, then settled there. ABUHAYYAN-FULL (ابن عباس): A report from Ibn ʿAbbās says God first placed angels in heaven and jinn on earth; after the jinn corrupted and fought, Iblis led angels who expelled them and took earthly rule. IBNKATHIR-FULL (الضحاك عن ابن عباس): Ibn Abbas, through al-Dahhak, says jinn first inhabited earth and shed blood; God sent Iblis to defeat and drive them to remote places, then created Adam to succeed them. IBNKATHIR-FULL (الضحاك عن ابن عباس): Jinn had corrupted the earth before Adam’s descendants, and the angels compared the new beings with them. DURR-FULL (ابن عباس): In Ibn Abbas's account, jinn first inhabited earth and fought, shed blood, and were defeated by Iblis and an angel army, who drove them to islands and mountain edges.
